purpose: Control experiment: does the SAME prompt twice produce the same title? If not, title differences between prompt variants are sampling noise, not comment content.
prompt: production thread prompt, identical across runs

runs.title: 福滤娃插件仓库突破700星作者致谢
福滤娃插件仓库获700+星标作者致谢
福滤娃插件仓库获超700星标作者致谢

conclusion: Identical inputs produced identical original_text but three different titles. Title variation is sampling non-determinism, so a title difference between the thread and post-only variants carries no evidence that comments changed the result.
